sn35.17:1.10: But since there is gratification in the tongue, sentient beings are aroused by it.
sn35.17:1.11: If the tongue had no drawback, sentient beings wouldn’t grow disillusioned with it.
sn35.17:1.12: But since the tongue has a drawback, sentient beings do grow disillusioned with it.
sn35.17:1.13: If there were no escape from the tongue, sentient beings wouldn’t escape from it.
sn35.17:1.14: But since there is an escape from the tongue, sentient beings do escape from it.
